title: PageSnap: Auto-OCR after capture, remove PDF export
description:
## Context
PageSnap (page snap/pagesnap/web_app.py) is a Flask app for automated book scanning with motion detection.

## Current flow
1. User captures pages (motion detection)
2. User manually clicks "Export PDF" or "Run OCR" 

## Desired flow
1. User captures pages
2. When user clicks "Stop Scanning", automatically run OCR on captured images
3. Show progress/status during OCR
4. Display or link to resulting markdown

## Changes needed
1. Remove "Export PDF" button from UI (line ~446 in web_app.py HTML)
2. Modify toggle_detection endpoint: when stopping (active=false), trigger OCR automatically
3. Add real-time OCR progress feedback to status endpoint
4. Show OCR result link when complete

## Files
- page snap/pagesnap/web_app.py - Main Flask app
- page snap/pagesnap/ocr_gemini.py - OCR processing with Gemini

## Acceptance criteria
- Clicking "Stop Scanning" triggers OCR automatically
- User sees progress during OCR
- PDF export button removed
- OCR markdown file accessible after completion
